title: A playlist as a linked list

ops.caption: To reach the chorus we walk from the head: intro, verse, chorus
Add a bridge after the chorus: chorus now points to bridge, bridge to outro
Drop the intro: verse becomes the head
Repeat the chorus: bridge now points to a second chorus, which points to outro
Reverse the playlist to play it backwards: outro is now the head
From the new head, outro is right here: 0 hops to find it
